_comment: Gates are DATA, not prose. A gate in a prompt gets interpreted; a table gets applied. Every program declares its own threshold. Re-verify each source before scaling - programs change (see: Canada Secondary Suite Loan Program, announced but never implemented).

programs.name: CMHC MLI Select
programs.note_if_gated_out: Requires a minimum of five rental units.

programs.name: GST/HST Purpose-Built Rental Housing (PBRH) Rebate
programs.source: Federal PBRH rebate; Ontario provincial component mirrors it
programs.note_if_gated_out: Requires four or more self-contained rental units.

programs.name: CMHC Prefab Plus
programs.note_if_gated_out: Feeds the MLI Select framework, so it carries the same five-unit minimum.

programs.name: Multigenerational Home Renovation Tax Credit
programs.note_if_gated_out: Applies only where the new unit houses a senior or DTC-eligible relative.

programs.name: Toronto Development Charge Waiver (Bill 185)
programs.note_if_gated_out: Toronto only. Does not apply outside the City of Toronto.

programs.name: Development-Charge Exemption for Additional Residential Units (Bill 23)
programs.source: Ontario More Homes Built Faster Act (Bill 23)
programs.note_if_gated_out: Covers the first two additional residential units only.

programs.name: County of Simcoe Secondary Suites Program
programs.gate_input: COUNTY level - applies to Barrie, Angus/Essa, Innisfil, Springwater. Check county, not just city.
programs.source: County of Simcoe Social Housing - verify against the current fact sheet

programs.name: Mississauga Fourth-Unit Incentive
programs.note_if_gated_out: Attaches to the fourth unit specifically. Not a blanket waiver.

scope_map._field_label: What sort of project are you consider?

Multiplex Development._note: Class is known (not 1 unit). Number is not. Render tiers across the as-of-right range, lead with multiplex tiers. NEVER scope to smallest - that strips programs a developer may qualify for.

Other._note: Read the sentence field first. If it names a number, treat as scoped. If not, render tiers and ask the scope question in the report.

capital_map._field_label: How much capital are you considering deploying?
capital_map._populated: 0/10 - UNUSABLE until the form makes it required

render_modes._principle: NEVER halt. A report is always produced. Unknown scope changes HOW it renders, not WHETHER it renders.

scoped.options: Lead with the stated goal. Larger options labelled as upside.
scoped.programs: Render only those clearing the stated scope. Programs clearing only a larger option move INTO that option's description. Programs no option reaches are dropped entirely.

tiered.options: Present tiers across the as-of-right range, smallest to largest.
tiered.programs: Attach each program to the SMALLEST tier that clears its gate. Show the threshold beside it. Never state a program as 'available to you' - it is available AT A TIER.
tiered.framing: This is the positive form of the gate: 'at 1 unit you have X; at 4 you also reach Y; at 5 you also reach Z.' It shows what scale unlocks - a sales asset, not a hedge.
tiered.ask: Put the scope question in the report itself, in the owner's language.

_hard_rule: No program is EVER stated as available without its gate satisfied or its threshold shown. Scoped mode satisfies it. Tiered mode shows it.
